correctness.rationale: Reconstructed every vertex of the PQ adjacency polytope as an ordered eligible pair (i,j), N=p²+2pq+q, n=p+q, and its exact block covariance C=((D/N-ww^T/N², B/N-ww^T/N²), symmetric) with B=[[Jp,J],[J,Iq]], w=(n 1p,(p+1)1q). Orthogonal symmetric/antisymmetric diagonalization gives C+= (D+B)/N -2ww^T/N² and C-=(D-B)/N=L/N. Mode multiplicities sum to 2n, including two normal zero modes. Independent exact full-matrix spectrum for (5,5),(5,6),(5,10),(8,3) matched eigenvalues 0(2), n/N(2p-1),p/N(q-1),(p+2)/N(q-1),n(p²+2p+q)/N²(1). Last vs p/N differs by -H_p(q)/N² where H_p=-q²+p(p-2)q-2p², producing all exact integer thresholds and ties (5,5),(5,10). All eigenvalues interpreted in the standard ambient Euclidean embedding and uniform distinct-vertex law.

value.rationale: Exact covariance eigenspaces and conditioning are natural quantitative geometry of a well-studied graph polytope; the least-variance mode changes twice in a single parameter family and only special integer sizes tie. This is a structural, complete classification, not merely recomputing the known Laplacian spectrum or normalized volumes.

limitations: Does not cover volume-uniform covariance or arbitrary affine embedding, power-flow counts, or general join graphs beyond K_p+E_q.
Integer p,q>=2; no claim of universal eigenspace transition in all PQ-type polytopes.
